title: Fuzzy Command Palette (Ctrl+P)
description: Global fuzzy search across issues, files, and commits. Sublime Text-style navigation with <200ms response time. The first addiction molecule.

title: Interactive Rebase Visualizer
description: Visual, keyboard-driven interactive rebase. Drag commits with j/k, squash, fixup, reword. Must be faster than `git rebase -i` in a text editor.

title: Smart Git Hooks Generator
description: Auto-generate commit-msg hooks that update issue status. `closes #42` marks Done, `refs #42` marks In Progress. Preserves existing user hooks.

title: Markdown Live Renderer in TUI
description: Render issue descriptions as styled markdown in detail view. Headers, bold, italic, code blocks, lists, blockquotes. Uses pulldown-cmark (~105 KiB).

title: Virtual Branches + Conflict Detection
description: GitButler-style virtual branches for parallel workflows. Hunk-level assignment, visual lanes (h/l navigation), real-time conflict detection between branches with warning indicators.

title: AI Agent Integration (Ollama)
description: Interactive modal menu with 7 curated AI actions: Explain Changes, Generate Tests, Refactor Code, Add Documentation, Find Bugs, Optimize Performance, Generate Commit Message. Non-blocking background execution.

title: Plugin SDK v0.1.0 (LuaJIT)
description: Ship progit-plugin-sdk as separate crate. Plugin trait with trait firewall (no mlua types in core). JSON-only boundary. 9 event types. LuaJIT runtime embedded. Example auto-tagger plugin.

title: Code Review Mode
description: Line-level code review system. `:review <file> [commit]` to enter. Press `c` to comment on any line. Inline indicators, comments sidebar, persistent storage in `.project/reviews/`. The GitHub killer feature.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Integration via Plugin
description: Real-time pipeline status in MR Dashboard. Color-coded indicators. Implemented as gitlab-ci Lua plugin, not hardcoded. Validates the entire plugin architecture end-to-end.

title: GitLab/Forgejo Bidirectional Sync
description: Full bidirectional issue sync with GitLab and Forgejo. MR integration, webhooks, deduplication logic. Remote ID mapping for multi-forge setups.

title: License Migration to Libertaria Stack
description: Migrate from EUPL-1.2/Apache-2.0 to LCL-1.0 (core) and LSL-1.0 (SDK). File-level copyleft with commercial bridge. Netherlands jurisdiction.

title: Website Launch (progit.dev)
description: Astro-based landing page, docs hub (Starlight), SDK docs, and plugin marketplace. Deployed to Cloudflare Pages. Design system: JetBrains Mono + Inter, terminal-native palette.

title: Version 0.7.0-alpha Release
description: Reclassify from beta to alpha. Honest status acknowledgment. Add call-for-testers section to website. Standardize all URLs to git.sovereign-society.org.

title: Binary Diet: Extract syntect to Plugin
description:
Remove syntect from core binary (~2MB savings). Ship as `syntax-highlight` Lua plugin. First plugin in the marketplace. Gateway drug to the ecosystem.

Target: <8MB stripped binary after removal.

title: Plugin Registry: `prog plugin install`
description:
Implement plugin install/uninstall from registry. Browse marketplace from TUI. Version management and dependency resolution.

```
prog plugin install syntax-highlight
prog plugin list
prog plugin remove slack-notify
```

title: Alpha Bug Triage
description:
Collect, categorize, and fix bugs reported by alpha testers. Priority: crashes > data loss > UX issues > cosmetic.

Tracking thread: call-for-testers on website.

title: Plugin View in TUI
description: Dedicated view mode for browsing installed plugins, their status, hooks, and configuration. Navigate with j/k, view plugin details with Enter.

title: Panopticum Integration Phase 2: Ops Tab
description: Dedicated infrastructure management view. Full-screen plan/apply, side-by-side diff, resource graph visualization, apply confirmation workflow with rollback support.

title: WASM Plugin Runtime (Optional Feature)
description:
Add wasmtime behind `--features=wasm` cargo flag. For banks/defense who demand sandboxing and plugins written in Rust/Go/Zig. Both LuaJIT and WASM ecosystems coexist.

Binary impact: +8MB (opt-in only).

title: CI Log Streaming in TUI
description: Stream CI/CD build logs directly into TUI. Real-time output with ANSI color support. Follow mode (tail -f style) with scroll-back.

title: Release Management in TUI
description: Create releases, generate changelogs from conventional commits, tag versions, publish release notes to forge. All without leaving the terminal.

title: GitHub Sync Support
description: Extend forge sync to support GitHub as a backend. Issue sync, PR integration, Actions status. Same deduplication logic as GitLab/Forgejo.

title: Jira Sync Plugin
description:
Bidirectional issue sync with Jira Cloud and Jira Server. Map ProGit statuses to Jira workflow. Lua plugin using HTTP stdlib.

Enterprise adoption enabler.

title: Identity Plugin (Commercial)
description:
Dumb client to proprietary reputation ledger. DID-based identity. Binary-only release at $499/yr. Talks to Ceramic/Ethereum nodes via HTTP.

This is the moat. Phase 4 only.

title: Svelte Web UI (Manager's View)
description:
Separate repo, 100% TypeScript/Svelte, ZERO Rust. Read-only web dashboard: burndown charts, velocity metrics, team overview. Talks to TUI daemon via JSON-over-HTTP.

Phase 4 only. Do NOT touch until Phase 3 complete.

title: Air-Gapped Enterprise Builds
description:
Pre-signed binaries for locked-down environments. No network calls, no telemetry, fully offline. Includes air-gapped plugin distribution.

Target: $25k-150k/yr contracts.

title: Advanced Theme Engine
description: Per-element color overrides via KDL config. Community theme sharing. Import themes from Alacritty/WezTerm configs. Live preview in settings panel.

title: HN Launch Post
description:
Draft and publish: "I replaced GitLab with a <10MB binary"

Requires:
- Binary <10MB (syntect removed)
- 10+ plugins in marketplace
- Documentation polished
- 3+ community testimonials

title: Multi-Repo Workspace Support
description: Manage issues across multiple repositories in a single Kanban board. Repo column in issue list. Filter by repo. Aggregate velocity metrics.

title: Discord/Matrix Community Setup
description: Create community channels for support, feedback, and plugin development. Bridge Discord and Matrix. Set up welcome bot and contributor roles.
